notes: Per-app UI memory (atlas). Coordinates are normalized 0-1000 against the full screen. Each state carries a 16x9 average-hash fingerprint of a real screenshot; a click on a named target resolves to atlas coordinates ONLY when the fresh screenshot's fingerprint is within hamming distance 28 of the state's fingerprint. map.proceed and combat elements are verify=false because their screens vary per run. Teach pass for this file: operator (teacher) drove the fixed flow once on 2026-10-27 and grounded every verified element from real screenshots; the teach run was abandoned so graded runs start clean.

keybinds.source: Read from the game's own Settings > Input screen (v0.111.0) by the operator on 2026-10-27 (screenshots op-keys3..op-keys8 in the live-driver shots folder). Active profile: Mouse + Keyboard (Keyboard-Only Mode OFF). The game is the authority for these bindings.
keybinds.combat_workflow: Hand slots are numbered left to right and the game prints the slot number above each card. Pressing a slot's number key selects that card. An attack then needs a target: click the enemy's body. Skills and powers self-resolve (select, then E confirms if it stays selected). E is both Confirm and End Turn: with a card selected it confirms, with nothing selected it ends the turn. Escape cancels a selection and backs out of menus and dialogs. There is no keyboard target selection in the mouse+keyboard profile.
